readout_other: BOLD fMRI during nociceptive heat stimulation; psychophysiological interaction effective connectivity; MR-ARFI beam mapping
direction_notes: FUS to thalamic VPL suppressed the heat-evoked BOLD response and reduced thalamocortical effective connectivity strength and inter-ROI correlation; the number of connected cortical regions fell from 19 to 15.
safety_notes: Thermal index for cranial bone calculated as 5.6; thermal simulation estimated a 0.25 C skull temperature rise during the 16 s block.

exposures.label: Thalamic VPL nucleus with heat stimulation (heat + FUS blocks)

timing.protocol_description: Trains of 650 kHz pulses, 500 ms pulse train duration, PRF 1 kHz, pulse duration 0.5 ms; the train is repeated at 0.5 Hz for 16 s, followed by 30 s rest, each condition repeated seven times; pulses ramped (50 us).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Four adult macaque monkeys (two female Macaca fascicularis and two male Macaca mulatta; average $\tt a g e = 1 0 \pm 3$ years; average weight = 7.5 ± 2.5 kg) participated in five MRI and FUS neuromodulation experimental sessions.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Three animals underwent one session each, and one animal underwent two sessions.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The FUS stimulation blocks consisted of trains of 650 kHz pulses,<sup>26</sup> 500 ms pulse train duration, pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1 kHz and pulse duration of 0.5 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The FUS stimulation blocks consisted of trains of 650 kHz pulses,<sup>26</sup> 500 ms pulse train duration, pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1 kHz and pulse duration of 0.5 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The FUS stimulation blocks consisted of trains of 650 kHz pulses,<sup>26</sup> 500 ms pulse train duration, pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1 kHz and pulse duration of 0.5 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: A 128-channel FUS array delivered 650 kHz pulsed US with a fast PRF of 1 kHz with a 50% duty cycle for 500 ms and a slow PRF of 0.5 Hz for 16 s.

flags.reason: 50% is the within-train duty cycle (Fig. 1E legend); the text also gives a duty cycle of 12.5% over the 16 s block (time-averaged power calculation).
16 s is the block length; each 500 ms train is repeated at 0.5 Hz within the block.

Simulation range of 761.75-902.74 kPa peak negative pressure differs from the stated target in vivo pressure of 550 kPa (free-field value derated by an assumed 39% transmission); only the simulated range is recorded.
Three animals had one session, one animal two sessions; recorded as a list.
Only the order of heat, FUS and heat + FUS blocks within runs is stated to be a randomized sequence; no group allocation.
Heat-only blocks serve as the no-FUS comparison within the same runs; no sham sonication.
